GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Blundered very badly on jumping, missed start 3 Lengths and Settled Down 7 Lengths on fence, made no ground to turn, shifted wider Straightening Up and improved 2 Lengths in straight. GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Blundered significantly on jumping & lost ground (~3L). App stated he had intended to settle in fwd posn however mount began poorly & was obliged to race at rear of field. App stated mount sprinted fairly to line down straight however was unable to make any significant ground on leading division from rearward position. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Wide trailing a half length, in Two Wide Outside Lead at the 800m, Moved Up to Two Wide joint Lead turning, took a narrow Lead at the 200m, kept going to post # won in a headbobber
Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. got clear in Straight # too good

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted wider Straightening Up and Held Ground in straight. (Blinkers OFF, Tongue Tie OFF) [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it settled handily and travelled comfortably early/middle stages, he was obliged to check when tightened rounding the home turn, it sprinted fairly once balanced on straightening but was unable to make any significant ground in straight. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr stated mount settled in a handy position & travelled comfortably in e&m stages. Rdr stated rounding home turn he was obliged to check his mount when momentarily tightened for room and as a consequence it lost ground and momentum. Rdr stated that once balanced up on straightening his mount sprinted fairly but was unable to make any significant ground on the leading division. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.
